sentences.en: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
sentences.zh: 那人想把快艇调头时，方向盘脱手掉了下来。

sentences.en: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 他拼命向同伴挥手，同伴在最后这十五分钟里一直在滑水。

chunks.x: to his companion who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes

sentences.en: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
sentences.zh: 两个人还没弄明白发生了什么事，就被猛地抛进了海里。

sentences.en: The speedboat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
sentences.zh: 快艇撞上了一个浮标，但仍继续在水面上疾驰。

sentences.en: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore,
sentences.zh: 两个人刚要向岸边游去，

sentences.en: when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
sentences.zh: 就惊恐地发现快艇正在转圈。

sentences.en: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
sentences.zh: 这时它正以极快的速度朝他们直冲过来。

sentences.en: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
sentences.zh: 不到一分钟，它就从他们身边几英尺外呼啸而过。

sentences.en: they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.
sentences.zh: 他们拼命往前游，因为他们知道快艇很快会再回来。

chunks.x: because they knew that the boat would soon return
that the boat would soon return

sentences.en: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
sentences.zh: 他们刚来得及游出危险区，快艇又转了一圈。

sentences.en: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.
sentences.zh: 不过这一次它已经大大放慢了速度。

sentences.en: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
sentences.zh: 不久，响声完全消失了，快艇开始在水面上轻轻漂荡。
